name: Kimi-Linear-REAP-35B-A3B-Instruct
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 1000000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct: 27 full GQA layers (kv heads 32, head_dim 72) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A 30% expert-pruned compression of moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, not a new base model and not a repack: the tensor set is smaller (35.132B against the base's 48B) but the architecture and tokenizer are unchanged. REAP removes 76 of 256 experts uniformly across all MoE blocks with no fine-tuning afterwards, so num_experts is set to the card's 180 rather than the inherited 256; num_layers 27, hidden_size 2304 and 8 activated experts are unchanged. Recorded as a contender because the card publishes benchmark evidence against its own base in one table; the rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Gains are mixed - it loses HumanEval+ 81.1/82.3, MBPP 83.6/84.1, MATH-500 80.8/81.8, GSM8k 85.8/87.3 and FRAMES 52.3/55.7 while winning HumanEval, MBPP+, LiveCodeBench, AIME25 and LongBench v2; the AIME25 row (40.0 vs 30.0, +10 points from pruning alone) is implausible and should be treated as unverified. Licence MIT, repo created 2025-11-06.
